name: The Hollow Mile
founded: ~200 Si (after the Censer's first continental purge)
summary: Velkash's underworld and the continent's black market for everything the Censer takes: banned books, Glimmer-touched relics, forged papers, and silence itself. Named for the mile of tunnels beneath Velkash's bridges. Every purge makes it richer; every raid makes it deeper.

history.event: Born of seizure: when the Censer's first continental purge fills its wagons, the overflow — forgeries, duplicates, outright lies — finds buyers in Velkash's under-bridges. The Mile is born as a fence's paradise.

The Great Collection backfires: the Censer seizes every Old Weaver text it can find, and the Mile becomes the only place a copy can be bought — at ten times the price. The Rememberers learn to sell here.
The Grey Peace: with few Glimmerborn left to hunt, the Censer's purges slow, and the Mile diversifies into gambling, smuggling, and the quiet trade in everything else.
The Rememberers' Return: scholars emerge from the Mile with genuine Old Weaver texts. The court protects them; the Censer hunts them; the Mile takes a cut from both sides.
A page of the Song Unbinding sells in the Mile for a king's ransom. It may be genuine. Three buyers are dead already, and the seller has vanished.

structure.leadership: no single head — the Mile is ruled by the Ledger, an anonymous council of fences who meet behind changing masks
structure.territory: the Hollow Mile: tunnels beneath Velkash's bridges; safehouses in every major city
structure.membership: unknown; anyone who sells, buys, or stays silent is 'of the Mile' until they aren't

goals: Keep no ledger that could ever be seized
Outlast the Censer — the one institution older than the trade itself
methods: Forged Censer warrants (the Mile's best-selling document)
Tunnel-couriers who never surface twice in the same district

relations.note: Each needs the other to justify its existence.
Half the watch is on the payroll; the other half is for sale.
The Mile moves the Rememberers' texts and never asks what they say. Mostly.

adventure_hooks: Players must buy a forged warrant from the Mile to enter the Censer Quarter — and discover the forger knows their real names.
A Mile fence offers the genuine page of the Song Unbinding at half price if players steal back his kidnapped daughter.
The Ledger summons the players: someone has been selling texts that implicate the Mile in the Year of Ashfall.
